body: Two timing fixes. (1) lib/pools.mjs withLockSync/withLock armed the deadline before getProcessStartTime(process.pid), which on darwin shells out to ps and can consume a short (50ms) timeout before any lock wait. Compute the deadline after the lookup; add a startTimeLookup option seam and a test that injects a lookup slower than timeoutMs and asserts the lock is still acquired. (2) bin/hook-runner.sh watchdog caches pidfile contents before SIGTERM and SIGKILLs 1s later after only kill -0, so a reaped and recycled pid can be killed. Re-read pidfiles before SIGKILL and kill only if unchanged; remove the child pidfile right after wait returns (stdin pidfile already was). Deterministic regression test in test/hook-runner.test.mjs: victim process records SIGTERM to a marker, test then removes the pidfile, asserts victim survives; runs under /bin/sh, dash, bash. Rebuild dist if shipped code changes. Done when env -u ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY npm test is green.
title: Fix macOS lock-timeout budget and hook-runner watchdog stale-PID SIGKILL
